descriptions.w3d_s10_service_forward_8020b680: Obtains a service and forwards the original object to virtual method slot 21.
descriptions.w3d_s10_create_entry_80208aac: Allocates and constructs a 44-byte entry, assigns its owner at offset 40, and initializes it with two zero arguments.
descriptions.w3d_s10_write_double_80204224: Passes the eight-byte double value by address to the observed writer with an explicit size of eight.
